text: I thought you would. I meant it as a pleasant surprise for the little mistress of Bleak House.” I kissed him and dried my eyes. “I know now!” said I. “I have seen this in your face a long while.” “No; have you really, my dear?” said he. “What a Dame Durden it is to read a face!” He was so quaintly cheerful that I could not long be otherwise, and was almost ashamed of having been otherwise at all.
